stories.title: Store employee tax code
stories.description: Add column tax_code to the employees table with a migration and backfill it from the HR import file.
ac: Column exists and is filled for active employees

stories.title: Withholding by tax code
stories.description: Compute monthly withholding in payroll/tax/TaxCalculator.cs using the tax_code read from the employees table.

stories.title: Payroll run endpoint
stories.description: Expose POST /api/payroll/run in payroll/api/RunController.cs; it starts a run and returns PayrollRunResponse with the run id and totals.

stories.title: Payroll dashboard run button
stories.description: The finance dashboard in portal/payroll/Dashboard.tsx calls POST /api/payroll/run and displays the totals from PayrollRunResponse.

stories.title: Payslip PDF
stories.description: Defines PayslipDto and renders it to PDF in payroll/pdf/PayslipRenderer.cs.

stories.title: Email payslips
stories.description: Monthly job sends each employee the payslip PDF via notify/PayslipMailer.cs using the template notify/templates/payslip.html.

stories.title: Bank transfer export
stories.description: Export the approved net pay as a SEPA file in payroll/bank/SepaExport.cs for the treasury team.
ac: File validates against the bank schema

stories.title: Index payroll runs by date
stories.description: Add index on payroll_runs table run_date via a new migration to speed up the history page.

stories.title: Leave balance widget
stories.description: Show remaining leave days in portal/leave/Balance.tsx on the employee home page.

stories.title: Vietnamese payslip email
stories.description: Translate the payslip email in notify/templates/payslip.html and add a Vietnamese variant notify/templates/payslip.vi.html.
ac: Vietnamese staff get the vi template

stories.title: Audit payroll runs
stories.description: Builds on P-3: record who triggered each payroll run in audit/PayrollAudit.cs.
ac: Every run has an actor in the audit log
